structural_assumptions: The first eight-bit word is seven address bits plus a bit-zero direction selector
Target ACK occupies the clock after eight received bits
Every eight transmitted bits are followed by an active-low controller ACK slot
Controller NACK ends TX even if another FIFO byte is ready
Preparing a ready TX byte still asserts stretch during resolved first-bit setup
Core integration requires shared open-drain RX/TX data and a distinct external clock
interpretation: Generic event port names coexist with a fixed protocol transaction graph; ready/data decisions operate within that graph
